elements.label: EXAMPLE 4.4
elements.title: Example 4.4: Confidence Interval Calculation for Average Commuting Distance

steps: Problem statement: Estimate average commuting distance for 5,000 employees by sampling 16 employees.
Sample mean = 15.8 miles, standard deviation = 3.2 miles.
Critical value for 99% confidence interval t_c = 2.947.
Margin of error E = t_c * (s / sqrt(n)) = 2.947 * (3.2 / 4) = 2.36.
Conclusion: 99% confident true mean commuting distance is between 13.44 and 18.16 miles.

elements.summary: This example demonstrates how to calculate a 99% confidence interval for the average commuting distance using sample data, including the margin of error and concluding statement.
